answer: To ensure Sybil resilience, our protocol mandates stake-slashing matrices integrated with zero-knowledge reputation commitments. This mechanism forces agents to jetty their decentralized capital into an ivory escrow, ensuring that any attempt to forge malicious identities results in a strictly negative expected utility exceeding the potential network reward. Such economic friction sustains a Nash equilibrium where Byzantine agents are mathematically disincentivized from collusion, preserving fault tolerance.
